items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: Tell me the story about how you met Tatum the first time... He introduced me to this little skinny guy. He said, 'This is the greatest piano player in the world.'

ctx.x: Tell me the story about how you met Tatum the first time.

Oh, you want to hear that? Well, it was the band I was playing... You know, one of the first bands I ever played with was in Columbus, Ohio. It wasn't the very first one, but it was one of the first ones. And the piano player came to me one day and said, 'Man, I want you to go with me and hear the greatest piano player in the world.' So I, you know, went along with him. I didn't know where he was going, but it wound up we went to a blind school in Columbus. And he introduced me to this little skinny guy. He said,…
